services.desc: Create a Website Account - Manage notification subscriptions, save form progress and more. The City of Marinette is committed to creating a safe, connected, and accessible community for everyone. The Bicycle & Pedestrian Plan serves as a guide for improving walking and biking throughout the city by identifying opportunities to enhance sidewalks, trails, bike routes, and pedestrian crossings. This page provides information on the plan, current initiatives, and future improvements that support safer, more connected transportation options for residents and visitors
